title: Merged cells table pptx 001
notes: real python-pptx cell.merge on a 3x3 table: horizontal merge (0,0)+(0,1) emits gridSpan=2 with an hMerge=1 continuation cell, vertical merge (1,2)+(2,2) emits rowSpan=2 with a vMerge=1 continuation cell (both asserted in slide1.xml). Unlike xlsx, merging does NOT drop the covered cells' text — all nine a:t strings stay in the XML and the renderer only displays the origin cells (seven visible: R0C0, R0C2, R1C0, R1C1, R1C2, R2C0, R2C1; R0C1 and R2C2 are merge-hidden). reference_text lists all nine inserted strings; text extractors must decide which convention to follow and say so.
